snippet.title: Temtem: Swarm - 1.0 Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Temtem: Swarm is exiting Early Access on Steam and will launch simultaneously on Steam, Steam Deck, and PlayStation 5 with full support for cross-platform play.
 
A version for the Nintendo Switch is also in development and will arrive at a later date.

Grab your squad and get ready to Temtem up on April 2nd!

Wishlist on Steam, pick up where you left off playing, or learn more here: http://crm.gg/fkdxg

💠 Join the discussion on Discord: https://discord.gg/temtem
💠 Subscribe to the Temtem Newsletter: http://crm.gg/6d9wa
